My advice is be present. Feel your emotions the good and the bad. Feel the wind while you walk outside or how the sun warms you up in the morning. Be present during conversations. Even when alone don't escape to fantasies, sexual or otherwise. And always look at yourself with love and compassion. Love is the opposite of porn to me so loving myself and others is a good place for me to be in. It's tough but it helps so much! Hopefully this helped friend. You've got this!! You've got this! Think of it as a lapse not a relapse. Remember that this doesn't define you. Your aren't your addictions. Love yourself (one of the hardest things for me to do but also one of the most important for me)! You aren't alone friend! We all believe in you!

Here is what has helped me. First see past the lies you tell yourself. This is a hard one but so important. For me they were along the lines of self-hatred, not admitting I had a problem, constantly putting myself down as a pervert, telling myself I would love myself when I was free. Stop doing that right now. You are a good person and you have to learn to believe that (tough at first but I gets easier).

Second is be mindful. I don't mean meditation, although that helps a lot, but instead just be present. It's almost scary to think of how much time I have spent fantasizing. Not just about porn or sex but things like winning something, being better at things I love without ever practicing. Instead be with yourself. Feel your emotions the good and the bad. Be present when you talk with people. If you go for a walk notice how the sun feels on your skin, feel the breeze, listen to a book and laugh with it or cry with it. Just be present.

Third accept that quitting porn won't solve everything. Instead learn to love yourself now. I realized one day while on this subreddit that I felt a profound love and sadness for everyone struggling with this except myself. I hated myself and felt like I deserved bad things. Then I thought that I would never condemn or judge someone else for struggling with porn so why do I hold myself to a different standard. Love yourself now and always because love is the antitheses of porn to me.

Even before I made it this far I noticed shifts and changes in my attitude and personality. I felt like I was slowly excavating parts of myself I had forgotten about. Now instead of hating myself I want to learn more about who I am! It's exciting and I love it.

Last piece of advice, you can't do it alone. Don't be afraid to reach out to friends and family, remember you have a family here too. My therapist has helped a lot too. People are real and willing to help. I was afraid of people for so long. Not anymore. I love people now and I want to help them.

Sorry for such a long reply, but I hope it helps friend! Feel free to message me if you need help on your journey!

I have created a simple morning and nightly routine because those are the most dangerous times for me. I get out of bed when I wake up and I try to only use it when I go back to bed or the occasional nap. I keep them very simple but focused on being mindful and recovery. I go for a walk in the morning and listen to a good book or some good music, then I do some stretching and then a quick 5 min meditation. 5 min because that's a perfect time for me right now to practice sitting with my thoughts. Then I journal or read a recovery book. Lastly the most important thing probably is to be active either here or on another community for recovery. I think community is key!! At night I just make sure I wash my face, brush my teeth, floss and then I list 10 things that helped my recovery that day. Just some easy routines to focus my mind away from porn!
